exact_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. HD game color diffuse texture, edit existing painted UV image, preserve its exact artwork.

Image1 is the ENTIRE original opaque native storedRGB 256x128 enlarged4x with NEAREST sampling solely to show exact existing UV paint. It is the same full source canvas without any artwork changes. Output entire same aspect 256:128 canvas and normalized UV. Original fullalpha restored separately; keep all storedRGB including black authoredpaint. No margin/padding/crop/zoom/island registration/rotation, no layouts shifted.

Keep every dark gray field as a low-contrast soft painted wash. The broad middle upper field is smooth quiet cloth, not granular or stippled. All old shadows remain weak and broad; do not add crease count or change old line phase. Preserve original narrow left boot field, the old center-left angular patch, existing vertical short-mark strip, the two middle panels and complete right dark field in identical relative positions. Original negative spaces and exact whole two-to-one canvas must remain. No new material texture, mottling, boot treads, stitching or stronger boundaries.

Keep original muted filtered hand-painted appearance, source brush softness, palette, relative local lightstrength and native scale. Gently resolve only existing low-resolution paint; keep all weak washes and small marks vague. Remove sampling steps without drawing new surfaces. Do not invent photographic weave, fibers, stipple, pores, metalgrain, raised rims, etching, shiny chrome, brighter white edges, new seams/buttons/straps/hardware, emblems or lettering. Preserve every existing dark gap, small mark, fold, count and phase. Do not brighten or sharpen weak diffuse washes into new structures. Increase resolution to four-times native dimensions while preserving source material and softness. No background texture added, no extraneous objects.
